reports.title: Adaptive Biotechnologies Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results

guidance.heading: 2026 Updated Financial Guidance
section: Adaptive Biotechnologies expects full year revenue for the MRD business to be between $276 million and $286 million, updated from the previous range between $268 million and $278 million. No revenue guidance is provided for the Immune Medicine business.
We expect full year total company operating expenses, including cost of revenue, to be approximately $350 million, updated from the previous range between $350 million and $355 million.
Management will provide further details on the outlook during the conference call.
